name: Media / Dashboard Screenshot
description: Dashboard Screenshot product scenario for the Media component.

controls.name: src
controls.description: URL of the source; a missing or empty one counts as a failed load.

controls.name: width
controls.description: Width of the box, pixels or a CSS length; wins over `style.width`. Default: the full available width.

controls.name: height
controls.description: Height of the box, pixels or a CSS length, which the media then fills; wins over `style.height`. Default: the media's own ratio.

controls.name: fallback
controls.description: Content shown in place of the media while its source is missing or failed to load.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around the box, for media aligned with a row of controls.

controls.name: type
controls.description: Element that renders the source: `image` (default), `video` or `audio`; the other props follow it.

controls.name: alt
controls.description: Text that stands for the image to people who cannot see it; `""` marks the image decorative.

controls.name: variant
controls.description: Frame of the image: the system radius (default), a circle cut from its center, or a bordered thumbnail.

controls.name: objectFit
controls.description: How the media fills a box whose height is set: `cover` crops, `contain` letterboxes. Default: cover for images, contain for video.

controls.name: loading
controls.description: `lazy` waits to fetch the image until it nears the viewport; `eager` (default) fetches it at once.

controls.name: decoding
controls.description: `async` (default) decodes the image off the main thread; `sync` shows it in the same frame as the content around it.

controls.name: controls
controls.description: Shows the browser's playback controls; without them only `autoPlay` or script can play the media.

controls.name: autoPlay
controls.description: Starts playback as soon as it can; most browsers block it unless the media is `muted`.

controls.name: loop
controls.description: Starts playback over from the beginning when it reaches the end.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the player for assistive technology.

controls.name: children
controls.description: Native `<track>` elements for captions, subtitles, descriptions or chapters.

controls.name: poster
controls.description: URL of the image shown until playback starts.

controls.name: playsInline
controls.description: Plays inside the page on iPhone instead of switching to fullscreen, as a background video needs.
